title: Critique: consciousness is known with certainty to exist

statements.text: Galen Strawson describes the twentieth-century denial of consciousness as an episode without parallel in the history of ideas: thinkers denied the existence of something known with certainty to exist. Dennett reports that Strawson cannot bring himself to contemplate strong illusionism.

sources.quote: A number of thinkers denied the existence of something we know with certainty to exist: consciousness, conscious experience.
who can’t bring himself to contemplate it
